items.title: PDL-CUL-26-003, Region of Waterloo Arts Funding Next Steps
notes:
R. Regier provided an introduction to the report and outlined the process as it pertains to the Regional Arts Fund Committee.

In reply to a question from the Committee, J. Kingston indicated there can be overlap with different types of art, and added that artists typically involved with Arts Fund are lens-based.

items.title: Motion to go into Closed Session

motions.text: That the Consent Agenda items be received for information and approved.
motions.text_html: That the Consent Agenda items be received for information and approved.

motions.item_title: COR-TRY-26-002, Write-off of Uncollectible Accounts for the Year Ended December 31, 2025
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo write off accounts receivable in the amount of $113,335.76 for the year ended December 31, 2025, as outlined in Report COR-TRY-26-002 dated January 13, 2026.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo write off accounts receivable in the amount of $113,335.76 for the year ended December 31, 2025, as outlined in Report COR-TRY-26-002 dated January 13, 2026.

motions.item_title: PDL-CUL-26-002, Public Art for Kitchener Central Transit Hub
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve the expenditure of up to $600,000 from the Public Art Reserve for a permanent public art acquisition at the Kitchener Central Transit Hub. And that the funding source for $300,000 earmarked for Public Art related to the Kitchener Central Transit Hub (project 90107) be amended from the approved 2026 Transit capital budget to the general tax supported capital reserve.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve the expenditure of up to $600,000 from the Public Art Reserve for a permanent public art acquisition at the Kitchener Central Transit Hub.

And that the funding source for $300,000 earmarked for Public Art related to the Kitchener Central Transit Hub (project 90107) be amended from the approved 2026 Transit capital budget to the general tax supported capital reserve.

motions.item_title: PDL-CUL-26-003, Region of Waterloo Arts Funding Next Steps
motions.text: That staff be directed to undertake consultations with the arts community, and the public in general, on the creation of a Waterloo Region Arts Council; and That staff be directed to report back on the results of the consultation by August 2026.
motions.text_html:
That staff be directed to undertake consultations with the arts community, and the public in general, on the creation of a Waterloo Region Arts Council; and
That staff be directed to report back on the results of the consultation by August 2026.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of the Council be held on January 28, 2026 immediately following Administration and Finance Committee, in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, regarding potential litigation related to water capacity update in the Region; Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, regarding potential litigation related to water capacity review in the Region; and Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to the Waterloo Police Services Board budget approval.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of the Council be held on January 28, 2026 immediately following Administration and Finance Committee, in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, regarding potential litigation related to water capacity update in the Region;
  2. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, regarding potential litigation related to water capacity review in the Region; and
  3. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to the Waterloo Police Services Board budget approval.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 4:22 p.m.
